firstScreen.notes: 1440-first.jpg: session-sheet document object with tape, clip and PASS stamp, so the signature is visible at 0%. One loud primary (Book a consult) plus a quiet Text us, phone in header, sample-labelled proof line. h1 'Clean you can check.' names no trade or place; those sit only in the mono eyebrow (-1.0 slogan, partly recovered by the eyebrow). Next band peeks only ~15px of tape (-0.5). 390-first.jpg: h1 2 lines, both actions above the fold, sheet peeks, call bar present.

distinctiveness.notes: Indicator tape divides every tone change (1440-full.jpg, 1440-scroll-75.jpg 'ENTRY 06 · PIERCING'), session sheet repeats as the estimator output, CHECKED stamp in hero, hygiene and reviews. Cover-the-logo works. Fully different from sibling A (1440-first of A is light vellum, serif, violet). -0.5 for heavy use of mono micro-labels, middle-dot meta strings and 01 · LOAD numbering (1440-scroll-25.jpg).

type.notes: Geist 800 display at tight tracking plus Hanken body and Martian Mono for readings is a coherent form-header system (1440-first.jpg). 1440-scroll-75.jpg: ear-map h2 runs 4 lines at 1440, estimator h2 3 lines. Too many small tracked mono caps labels per view (1440-first.jpg eyebrow, sheet keys, status line, SAMPLE pills) (-0.5).

layout.notes: 1440-rm-full.jpg: tones alternate deep/paper/deep/light/photo/paper/deep/paper/rose/light/deep, no two dark bands touching, the full-bleed photo break and rose reviews band land. The services ledger is a long flat run of 10 identical rows (1440-full.jpg) and the hygiene section leaves an empty left column under the stamp (1440-scroll-50.jpg); density map flattens in the middle.

photo.notes: 1440-scroll-50.jpg: the only photograph on the page; on-topic (gloved hand, film-wrapped machine, ink caps) but the machine grip shows readable brand lettering and a sticker wall with legible text sits at the left edge (-1.5, mustFix). One frame for a whole tattoo homepage gives no sequence and no grade to judge; the rest is SVG.

copy.notes: Voice matches the concept ('Your needles come sealed. You watch us open them.', 1440-scroll-25.jpg; 'The price on this page is the price in the chair.'). Primary action named 'Book a consult' everywhere, Sample labels present on rating, sheet and prices. Headlines over 2 lines at 1440 (ear map, estimator, 1440-scroll-75.jpg) (-0.5); h1 lacks the trade word.

mobile.notes: 390-first.jpg: h1 2 lines, both buttons above fold, sheet re-cut untilted and peeking, Text/Call/Book bar. 390-full.jpg: ledger, cycle cards and estimator stacked for the thumb, no sideways scroll (render.json overflow clean at 320 and 390).

a11y.notes: 1440-rm-full.jpg and 390-rm-full.jpg show every word, gauge static at 134°C, tapes drawn. forced-colors and print rules present in dist. Heading order h1>h2>h3 clean. Focus styling and widget ARIA not observable in the screenshots, so held at the 8.5 band.

motion.notes: 1440-scroll-25.jpg: pinned cycle story with a dialling gauge and active step, motion that explains the autoclave order. Hooks in dist: split, count, hotspots, carousel, marquee, tape progress. Reveals elsewhere are uniform data-reveal fades; the tape darkening is not readable in any captured frame as a distinct moment.

wow.notes: The cycle gauge story (1440-scroll-25.jpg) plus the estimator that prints a session sheet in the hero's own language (1440-scroll-75.jpg top, 'Book with this sheet') and the ear map with tape tag: signature tied to the trade's real fear (hygiene). Ear tag box is an empty dashed panel until tapped (1440-scroll-75.jpg).

polish.notes: apple-touch, OG 1200x630, JSON-LD, print and forced-colors present in dist. 1440-first.jpg 'CYCLE_0412' and 1440-scroll-75.jpg 'ENTRY _06_ · PIERCING', 'TAG · _PICK_A_SPOT': stray underscore/underline artefacts in every tape label (-0.5).

mustFix.problem: Readable brand lettering on the tattoo machine grip and legible sticker wall text at the left edge (readable logo/sign rule)
mustFix.fix: Re-crop with object-position so the grip lettering and sticker wall fall outside the frame (e.g. object-position: 70% 75% with a tighter aspect), or swap to another approved frame from the niche manifest without visible branding

elevate.move: Give photography a role in the log: add 2-3 approved frames (tray setup, sealed pouch, healed piece) set as taped evidence prints clipped into the log entries (cycle story, hygiene, reviews), all in one graphite-rose duotone so they read as one shoot and tell setup → cycle → result

Make the h1 carry trade and city inside the log language (e.g. a sheet header line 'Philadelphia tattoo & piercing, logged') and cut the hero to ~88svh so the services ledger's first tape-sealed entry peeks 80px under the fold
